fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of sorted unique modified/untracked paths, NUL, full file bytes, NUL; excludes tests/evidence/; includes preserved ADR-0024 and B1 work

database.source: existing postgres:17; no pull or download
database.isolation: dedicated internal network, no host database port, synthetic data only
tested: Payment, Invoice and TripEvidence: first and repeated correction, stable Fact identity, original confirmation replay, paginated immutable history and genuine AI/manual source preservation
invoice item replacement retains old item IDs/origins; current list reads only the current revision in a consistent database snapshot
valid links retained; lower amount, changed currency or dates beyond 30 days blocked unless the user explicitly withdraws conflicting links
final-write injection rolls back Claim, Review, Fact, Link, origins, audit and correction history
changed relationships invalidate preview; different-key concurrency has one winner; same-key replay produces one correction
self excluded from duplicates, changed duplicate target revision invalidates preview, exact invoice number conflict blocks
automatic attribution: unique, overlapping and unmatched intervals; manual and blocked preferences preserved; ticket correction does not move material links or rewrite trip containers
submitted, reimbursed and rejected snapshots/status history unchanged; new preview binds current field revision and stable Fact reuse policy
four-role and tenant boundaries, actual PostgreSQL-backed HTTP authentication, CSRF and strict request validation
0004 upgrade preserves three Fact types, source history and invoice items; injected migration failure rolls back data/schema/ledger; repeated migration and correction after upgrade pass

critical_invariants.method: all package/test identities matched uncached final pass events

statement_coverage.method: unique statement blocks with any positive atomic count; existing layer boundaries unchanged

go.vet: all packages and postgresql_tools backup tests passed
go.build: all packages and static postgresql_tools test binary passed

authenticated_restore.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -p 1 -tags postgresql_tools -c ./cmd/backup; run compiled test in existing postgres:17 with explicit SBM_PG_DUMP_PATH/SBM_PG_RESTORE_PATH and -test.timeout=60s
authenticated_restore.limit: focused regression fixture, not a new 1000-Document exercise

web.scope: real production-built components with synthetic mocked API plus separate database-backed HTTP integration; not a deployed runtime browser release gate
covered: all three Fact types correct with genuine source identity and history
409 refresh preserves draft and requires explicit recheck
removed invoice item shows old values and deletion before confirmation
late historical response cannot survive a workspace refresh
web.visual_review: 384px light and 1440px dark captures inspected; responsive/contrast assertions passed

failure_history.cause: trip fixture arguments and confirmation association mode did not match the TripEvidence contract
failure_history.resolution: correct synthetic fixture; retain production boundary; rerun passed

failure_history.cause: shared revision publishing would change completed Job, ordinary confirmation replay could consume a correction key, and duplicate target revision was not bound
failure_history.resolution: separate Claim contents from Job publishing, enforce replay operation identity and bind current target ReviewDecision; regression tests pass

failure_history.cause: removed invoice item omitted from preview and historical loading state could survive refresh
failure_history.resolution: show removed fields and invalidate pending history state; add and pass browser cases

failure_history.cause: four tests matched both success and transient loading status nodes
failure_history.resolution: scope success assertion by visible message; complete 33-test suite rerun twice without retries

failure_history.cause: tool paths differed between application defaults and existing PostgreSQL image
failure_history.resolution: verify actual PostgreSQL 17 executable paths, configure existing supported path settings and rerun real dump/restore; no fake dump

review.scan_limit: known key/private-key patterns and scoped diff review, not universal secret detection
review.read_only_agents: business/database concurrency and UI error/history behavior reviewed; main agent implemented and verified all edits

resources.swap: pre-existing 3898 MiB used; no expanded limits or OOM retry
resources.credentials: one-time synthetic, owner-only temporary files; never emitted or committed

not_performed: real Provider/mailbox/account integration or model correctness evaluation
